title: Every sale email says which fee rule applied: the one-time finder's fee on a buyer Frequency introduced, or none

source.ref: ADR-1978 item 7 ("Every sale email says which rule applied"), owner ruling 2026-11-18 (project thread: Rethink our take rates).

detail: A host read "Frequency's fee on this sale was $4" on a ticket and "Network fee: $1.20" on a shop sale, with no reason, and a donation notice showed no fee at all. Under ADR-1978 a fee is charged on exactly one kind of sale, the first purchase from a customer Frequency introduced, so the fee itself says which rule applied. DONE 2026-11-19: the ticket sale email says "Frequency introduced this buyer, so this sale carried the one-time finder's fee of $X. You will not pay it again for them." or "Frequency took nothing on this sale: no finder's fee applied."; the split shop sale notice labels the row "Finder's fee, once (Frequency introduced this buyer)"; the donation notice shows the same row when the gift carried one. Known limit: the single-seller shop notice and the membership join notice show no fee rows at all, as before.

verify.note: Passes while the three notices name the rule. Fails on main at a5684bf86.
